{{Quote|I've studied you, followed your exploits across the galaxy. You're a personal hero of mine.|The SIS assassin faces the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />}}
An '''assassin''' was in the employ of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Baras]] around [[3640 BBY]]. An [[Darth Baras' spy network|agent]] for Baras within the ranks of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] (SIS), this [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] operated as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and was entrusted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]&mdash;along with two other operatives&mdash;with [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Darth Vowrawn]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I know who you are. You're the apprentice Darth Baras thought he had killed. Marvelous.|The SIS assassin, to the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hired]] by three different [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to kill the rogue [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]]'s [[Beelzlit Grathan|son]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but the issue with Grathan and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Parent/Legends|heir]] was resolved by an [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]].<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

Around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> as the conflict with the Republic waged on and intensified into the [[Galactic War]], the power-hungry Baras became a [[Dark Council]]lor of the [[Politics/Legends|Empire]] and severed his [[Sith Master/Legends|mentorship]] with the very same [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] who stepped in on the Grathan issue, as the Councillor saw the rising Sith as a threat. Amidst the absence of the [[Valkorion|Sith Emperor]] and the [[Sel-Makor|disappearance]] of the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]] on [[Voss]], Baras also declared himself the new Voice before the Dark Council. He was met with only one voice of opposition&mdash;[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Vowrawn]]&mdash;who openly challenged Baras' bid.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

Seeking to eliminate opposition, Darth Baras contacted three assassins to remove Vowrawn, who was entrenched in the [[Battle of Corellia]] against both [[Corellian/Legends|local]] resistance and [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]]. One assassin was an SIS personnel, who travelled to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to fulfill his highly dangerous mission, not daring to infringe the powerful Darth Baras.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

[[File:Servant_Eleven_holo.png|thumb|left|224px|Agents of the Hand took action to undermine Darth Baras' bid for the Voice together with the Wrath.]]
The SIS assassin took a<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" /> [[Fortitude-class assault shuttle|''Fortitude''-class assault shuttle]],<ref name="The Lucky Lancer codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Lucky Lancer}}</ref> landing it on the rooftop of the [[Gannir Executive Suites]] [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of Corellia and descended from the Assassin [[Starship/Legends|Ship]]. On the roof, the operative prepared to assassinate the nearby Vowrawn, who led Imperial forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from within a Republic facility as a security precaution.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

However, the former apprentice of Darth Baras made retaliation efforts against the self-proclaimed Emperor's Voice, and with agents of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]&mdash;a organization within the Sith Empire loyal to the Emperor&mdash;secured intelligence of the assassination attempts, and the former apprentice&mdash;now a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the [[Emperor's Wrath]]&mdash;had routed the first assassin, an Imperial droid, and reached the roof of the building upon which the SIS assassin stood via the building's [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

Intercepted by the Emperor's Wrath, a [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|confrontation]] ensued, and the assassin was ultimately killed by the Wrath, who proceeded to defeat the third assassin on a nearby skyscraper, thus protecting Vowrawn and foiling Baras' plans.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A welcoming committee. Some days you just can't land secretly on a planet. Even on a private landing strip.|On the Gannir Executive Suites rooftop, the SIS assassin is confronted by a Sith Lord none other than the former apprentice of Darth Baras and the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />}}
The assassin was impressed by the Wrath's dealings against Lord Grathan, [[Nomen Karr]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk]], the [[War Trust]], and countless [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Having studied the Darth Baras' former apprentice in a slightly obsessive manner, the SIS assassin knew that the Sith Lord confronting himself was the former apprentice of Darth Baras, and was honored to meet his personal hero, wanting to let the Wrath know of his personal appreciation as much as he was confident in defeating his opponent. This was not to be, however, as the agent was bested by the Emperor's Wrath.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In my profession, you're well-known. But I'm somewhat obsessed, I admit.|The SIS assassin converses with the Emperor's Wrath|<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />}}
[[File:SIS_Assassin_landing.png|thumb|right|250px|The SIS Assassin lands on the Gannir Executive Suites building.]]
The assassin is introduced in the Sith Warrior-class storyline of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he is identified by his nametag as "'''SIS Assassin'''." His ship is also given a conjectural name, being labelled "Assassin's Ship."<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />

If the player allows the assassin to speak, the assassin would reveal that he studied the player in great detail, admitting his near-obsessive observation of the Emperor's Wrath. Revealing his admiration for the Sith Lord, Baras' assassin then also divulged his view that the player would be bested as he himself had analysed his personal hero and opponent's tactics. Ultimately, he ruefully expresses his view of the Sith's impending death as unfortunate and attacks the player, only to fall to the Wrath's blade.<ref name="Protect Vowrawn" />
